name: Being Born In To Sin
overview: Scripture reveals that humanity is inherently sinful from the very beginning of life, as seen in Psalms 51:5 where David acknowledges being formed in iniquity and conceived in sin. Psalms 58:3 further emphasizes that the wicked are estranged from birth, going astray from the womb. Romans 5:12 explains the origin of this condition, stating that sin entered the world through one man, resulting in death spreading to all because all have sinned. Together, these verses affirm the biblical truth of being born into sin, highlighting the universal need for redemption through Christ.
